Aisha L: Quick intro 33hi team 33I completed HR but I'm stuck on two items: HubSpot shows 'pending seat' and Dialpad says 'no number assigned'. Who handles telecom/CRM?

Tom (Sales Ops): Welcome @Aisha! Send over your emp id and email and Ill queue HubSpot + Gong. Dialpad numbers are Telecom-managed; we usually put SDRs in the shared pool.

Aisha L: emp id RWF-2499, aisha.l@redwood.ai. Thanks Tom.

buddy-bot: Welcome Aisha! You've been added to #sales and assigned the Sales First-Week checklist.

Ravi (IT): @Aisha L I see a pending Telecom allocation. I'll request placement in shared pool now. If you need a dedicated DID, file TELE-77 or DM me.

Aisha L: Shared pool is fine. Also curious about permissions: can SDRs tag Gong recordings for enablement use?

Nora (Enablement): SDRs can add #coaching and #demo tags. #training requires enablement/legal approval. Use #sensitive for any PII and don't upload outside the org.

Tom (Sales Ops): OPS-3210 created for HubSpot + Gong invites. Expect emails from ops@redwood.ai and enablement@redwood.ai within 20m.

Ravi (IT): Telecom placed you in shared pool. Dialpad should show a number in the app within ~10m. Try logging out and back in or use the web client if it doesn't appear.

Aisha L: I see the Dialpad number now, and HubSpot invite just arrived. Accepted HubSpot. Thanks everyone!

Nora (Enablement): Great. For week 1 focus: SDR playbook (https://redwood.docs/sales/onboarding/sdr-week1), cold intro script, and two shadow sessions. I'll assign a buddy shortly.

Tom (Sales Ops): Checklist for Aisha: [x] HR, [x] HubSpot, [x] Dialpad number, [ ] Gong (pending). Ping here if Gong invite doesn't show up.

Aisha L: Will do. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :heart:

(END OF THREAD)
